name: Solve this quantum programming problem. Implement the 3-qubit bit-flip code in Q
task_prompt: Solve this quantum programming problem. Implement the 3-qubit bit-flip code in Qiskit with dynamic circuits: encode RY(1.474)|0>, apply an X error on qubit 1, extract the syndrome with two ancillas, correct with if_test, and verify the decoded statistics over 4096 shots. Write the full runnable code (all imports included); executing it should print the results.
